### Solomon’s Accomplishments and Renown
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/solomons-accomplishments-and-renown
Passage: 2 Chronicles 9:1
Points:
- King Solomon’s reign was ancient Israel’s golden age of wealth, influence, and international prominence.
- The Queen of Sheba visited Jerusalem to test Solomon's wisdom and witness his kingdom firsthand.
- Solomon demonstrated immense generosity by giving the queen even more gifts than she had brought.
- Material blessings and faithful obedience to God are not mutually exclusive.
- Believers should neither serve God merely for wealth nor feel guilty when He grants material success.
